whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2026–27
content: The 2027–28 school year starts one day earlier, on August 23 instead of August 24.
Spring Break moves later, from March 22–26 in 2026–27 to April 10–14 in 2027–28.

Which GCS teacher workdays are no-school days for students?
Is January 3 part of GCS Winter Break?

calendarFaqs.q: Does every GCS school follow the Traditional Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Most GCS schools use the Traditional Calendar, but extended-year schools and some early/middle college programs follow separate academic calendars. Confirm the calendar assigned to your student's school or program.

calendarFaqs.q: Which GCS teacher workdays are no-school days for students?
calendarFaqs.a: Students do not attend on optional teacher workdays October 11, November 5, and January 3, or mandatory teacher workdays October 29, January 24, March 7, and March 31.

calendarFaqs.q: Is January 3 part of GCS Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The official Winter Break ends December 31. Monday, January 3 is a separate optional teacher workday, and students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded 2027–28 calendar update if GCS revises the schedule?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import, not a live subscription. Check the official GCS calendar for later revisions.

Return dates use the next student attendance day after each published break and account for the separate January 3 optional teacher workday.
The official file is a future-year calendar last revised January 13, 2026. Check the GCS calendar page for later revisions before making long-term plans.
